panels.title: ASR — last 15m
panels.description: Answer-Seizure Ratio = answered_calls / total_calls over the last 15 minutes, on the selected zone. THE headline carrier metric. answered = answer_time IS NOT NULL. Green >= 55%, amber >= 40%, red below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL))::float / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS asr FROM cdrs WHERE start_time > now() - interval '15 minutes' AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone';

panels.title: Concurrent calls (CDR-derived)
panels.description: Calls currently in progress right now, derived from CDR time-overlap: rows where answer_time <= now() < end_time (a call is up between answer and hangup). This is the RELIABLE concurrency source. active_calls is NOT used — it is only populated by the programmable-voice API path, not the RCF path that carries production traffic.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS concurrent FROM cdrs WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL AND answer_time <= now() AND end_time > now() AND start_time > now() - interval '6 hours' AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone';

panels.title: CPS — last 1m
panels.description: Calls per second = count of seized calls (by start_time) in the last 60s / 60, on the selected zone. Rated capacity is ~500 CPS per zone; amber/red are set for the all-zones view. See Traffic Status for per-zone / per-node CPS.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::float / 60.0 AS cps FROM cdrs WHERE start_time > now() - interval '1 minute' AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone';

panels.title: Avg MOS — last 15m
panels.description: Mean Opinion Score averaged over answered, rated calls in the last 15m (mos IS NOT NULL). MOS is NULL on unanswered/unrated calls and those are excluded. Carrier-good >= 4.0, degraded 3.5-4.0, poor < 3.5.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(mos) AS avg_mos FROM cdrs WHERE start_time > now() - interval '15 minutes' AND mos IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone';

panels.title: On-net % — last 15m
panels.description: Share of calls short-circuited internally (carrier hairpin avoided): count(*) FILTER (WHERE on_net) / count(*). New internal-routing metric. on_net is a boolean set by FreeSWITCH; NULL/false = off-net.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE on_net))::float / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS on_net_pct FROM cdrs WHERE start_time > now() - interval '15 minutes' AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone';

panels.title: MOS trend — avg / p10 (10m)
panels.description: Mean MOS and the 10th-percentile (worst-decile) MOS per 10m, selected zone, answered+rated only. avg tells the headline; p10 exposes the worst calls even while the average looks fine.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '10m') AS time, avg(mos) AS avg_mos, percentile_cont(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY mos) AS p10_mos FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND mos IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Packet loss % — avg / p95 (10m)
panels.description: Average and p95 of packet_loss_pct per 10m, selected zone. packet_loss_pct is flaw_total-based (RTP sequence-gap network loss) — the old value counted autoflush discards, fixed at ingest and backfilled by migration 43. Floored to meaningful calls (≥10s billable, ≥500 inbound RTP packets). Anything sustained above ~1% is audible. p95 catches the worst calls. Only calls ≥10s are included (short calls have unstable loss stats).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '10m') AS time, avg(packet_loss_pct) AS avg_loss_pct, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY packet_loss_pct) AS p95_loss_pct FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND packet_loss_pct IS NOT NULL AND billable_ms >= 10000 AND rtp_audio_in_packet_count >= 500 AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Per-zone call volume — hourly
panels.description: Seized calls per hour per zone as one line per zone (zone from freeswitch_node). Watch load balance across East / West / Central. All zones shown regardless of the Zone filter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '1h') AS time, CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END AS zone, count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Total call volume — hourly
panels.description: Whole-platform offered volume: seized calls per hour from raw cdrs over the range (all zones). The headline traffic curve.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '1h') AS time, count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: SIP response classes — over time
panels.description: sip_code bucketed into response classes, 10-minutely, selected zone. NULL sip_code (never got a final response) shown as 'none'. A growing 4xx/5xx band is the earliest sign of a carrier/routing fault.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '10m') AS time, CASE WHEN sip_code IS NULL THEN 'none' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN '2xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 300 AND 399 THEN '3xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 400 AND 499 THEN '4xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 500 AND 599 THEN '5xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 600 AND 699 THEN '6xx' ELSE 'other' END AS class, count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Carrier split — inbound by carrier / PoP (10m)
panels.description: Inbound (direction='inbound') seized calls per 10m, one series per ingress carrier-PoP from cdrs.inbound_carrier + inbound_carrier_pop (stamped spoof-proof by Kamailio from the verified source IP; FS records them as channel vars). Series values are bounded: bandwidth-dallas / bandwidth-la / bandwidth-ny / bandwidth-atlanta, sinch-denver / sinch-chicago, bare 'bandwidth' = trusted-but-unmapped Bandwidth IP or pre-attribution rows (NULL folded to bandwidth — it was the only orig carrier then). A Sinch orig test call (test TNs 5305480845 Denver / 5305480846 Chicago) appears here as a sinch-denver / sinch-chicago bump once the call hangs up and its CDR lands. Honours the Zone filter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '10m') AS time, COALESCE(inbound_carrier, 'bandwidth') || COALESCE('-' || NULLIF(inbound_carrier_pop, ''), '') AS carrier_pop, count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND direction = 'inbound' AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Quality detail — jitter / MOS distribution / R-factor / quality % (rated calls only)
Peak jitter — avg / p95 (10m)
panels.description: Per-call PEAK running jitter: jitter_max_ms = sqrt of FreeSWITCH's max inter-arrival variance — the worst running jitter std-dev of the call, in real ms (migration 43 converted historical rows from raw variance). avg = average of per-call peaks; p95 = p95 of per-call peaks (the worst calls). Floored to meaningful calls (≥10s billable, ≥500 inbound RTP packets) so sub-second calls don't dominate. The portal's jitter_avg_ms (RMS mid-band estimate) trends lower than peak by design. Only calls ≥10s are included (short calls have unstable jitter stats).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '10m') AS time, avg(jitter_max_ms) AS avg_peak_jitter_ms, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY jitter_max_ms) AS p95_peak_jitter_ms FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND jitter_max_ms IS NOT NULL AND billable_ms >= 10000 AND rtp_audio_in_packet_count >= 500 AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: MOS distribution
panels.description: Distribution of per-call MOS over the dashboard time range, selected zone, mos IS NOT NULL (unrated/unanswered excluded). A healthy carrier is bunched at 4.0-4.5. A left tail toward 3.x is audio degradation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT mos FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND mos IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone';

panels.title: R-factor trend — avg (10m)
panels.description: Average ITU R-factor per 10m, selected zone, r_factor IS NOT NULL. Toll-quality >= 80; 70-80 acceptable; < 70 users notice. Complements MOS (same underlying E-model).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '10m') AS time, avg(r_factor) AS avg_r_factor FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND r_factor IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Quality % trend — avg (10m)
panels.description: Average FreeSWITCH rtp_audio_in_quality_percentage per 10m, selected zone, quality_pct IS NOT NULL. This is FS's own composite call-quality score (0-100). Tracks MOS/R-factor but is a single ready-made number.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '10m') AS time, avg(quality_pct) AS avg_quality_pct FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND quality_pct IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Delivery — answered vs failed / ASR trends / ACD / PDD
Answered vs failed — per 5m
panels.description: Seized calls bucketed 5-minutely into answered (answer_time present) vs failed (never answered). Stacked. A rising failed band with flat answered = a routing/carrier problem.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '5m') AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL) AS answered, count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NULL) AS failed FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: ASR trend per zone — hourly
panels.description: Answer-Seizure Ratio per zone per hour from raw cdrs (cdr_hourly_stats has no sbc_id, so zone attribution needs raw rows). answered / seized. Spans all zones side by side; NOT filtered by the Zone variable so zones can be compared.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '1h') AS time, CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END AS zone, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL))::float / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS asr FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: ASR trend per carrier — hourly
panels.description: ASR per carrier_used per hour on the selected zone — one series per carrier value, so table-driven trunks (bandwidth-dallas, bandwidth-la, sinch-atlanta-ld, sinch-denver-tf, future carriers) appear automatically. Legacy enum rows are folded to readable labels: carrier_primary -> bandwidth-dallas, carrier_secondary -> bandwidth-la (the East/Central mapping; pre-fold West rows labeled these enums the same way even though West's primary PoP was LA). 'local'/'default'/NULL excluded. Divergence between lines pinpoints a carrier/PoP-side answer problem.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '1h') AS time, CASE carrier_used WHEN 'carrier_primary' THEN 'bandwidth-dallas' WHEN 'carrier_secondary' THEN 'bandwidth-la' ELSE carrier_used END AS carrier, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL))::float / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS asr FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND carrier_used IS NOT NULL AND carrier_used NOT IN ('local','default','') AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: ACD — avg call duration (hourly)
panels.description: Average answered-call duration in seconds, from cdr_hourly_stats.avg_duration_sec (already answered-only, cheap continuous aggregate). Customer-scoped aggregate has no zone dimension, so this is all-zones. A sudden ACD collapse often means calls answering then failing fast (dead air / media).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(hour, '1h') AS time, sum(total_duration_sec)::float / NULLIF(sum(answered_calls), 0) AS acd_sec FROM cdr_hourly_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: PDD proxy — p50 / p95 time-to-answer (10m)
panels.description: APPROXIMATION of Post-Dial Delay: percentiles of (answer_time - start_time) over answered calls, 10-minute buckets, selected zone. This is CDR time-to-ANSWER, not true PDD to the first 18x provisional — true PDD needs Homer/SIP timing. Watch p95 for carrier slowness.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '10m') AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (answer_time - start_time))) AS p50_s, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (answer_time - start_time))) AS p95_s FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND answer_time IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Carrier detail — share / per-carrier ASR / egress / live ingress
Carrier share — range total
panels.description: Share of calls by carrier_used over the range + zone. carrier_primary=Dallas, carrier_secondary=LA, local=on-net, default=unset. Heavy 'secondary' means primary is failing over. Range-aggregate pie over the selected range + zone (the time-based split lives in the priority band).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE carrier_used WHEN 'carrier_primary' THEN 'Dallas (primary)' WHEN 'carrier_secondary' THEN 'LA (secondary)' WHEN 'local' THEN 'On-net (local)' WHEN 'default' THEN 'Unset (default)' ELSE COALESCE(carrier_used, 'null') END AS carrier, count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: ASR by inbound carrier — hourly
panels.description: Answer-Seizure Ratio per INGRESS carrier per hour (inbound legs only) — the origination-side counterpart of the egress 'ASR trend per carrier' panel above (same value-agnostic pattern: one series per cdrs.inbound_carrier value, so any carrier admitted via carrier_trunks appears automatically). Today that is 'bandwidth' vs 'sinch' (NULL pre-attribution rows folded to bandwidth). A sinch line diverging below the bandwidth line = calls arriving via Sinch are failing to answer — an origination-path problem, not a destination problem. Honours the Zone filter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '1h') AS time, COALESCE(inbound_carrier, 'bandwidth') AS inbound_carrier, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL))::float / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS asr FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND direction = 'inbound' AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Egress volume by carrier trunk — hourly
panels.description: Outbound B-leg volume per egress trunk per hour from carrier_used — the volume companion of the 'ASR trend per carrier' panel (same value-agnostic fold: carrier_primary -> bandwidth-dallas, carrier_secondary -> bandwidth-la; table-driven values like sinch-atlanta-ld / sinch-denver-tf pass through untouched, so a Sinch TERMINATION sign-off attempt shows here as its own series the hour it happens — carrier_used records the winning/last bridge attempt). 'local' (on-net) / 'default' / NULL excluded. Honours the Zone filter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '1h') AS time, CASE carrier_used WHEN 'carrier_primary' THEN 'bandwidth-dallas' WHEN 'carrier_secondary' THEN 'bandwidth-la' ELSE carrier_used END AS carrier, count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND carrier_used IS NOT NULL AND carrier_used NOT IN ('local','default','') AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Live carrier ingress — SBC admits per 5m
panels.description:
LIVE ingress from the SBCs, not the CDR: sum by trunk of increase(kamailio_trunk_cps{direction='inbound'}[5m]) — Kamailio increments this xhttp_prom counter (NO _total suffix) once per admitted inbound INVITE, so a Sinch orig test call shows a ~1-call bump on the 'sinch' series within a scrape interval, while the call is still up and before its CDR exists. Trunk label is a closed enum: tc1 / tc2 / tc4 = Bandwidth trunk configs (tc4 = default PoPs), 'sinch' = Sinch origination (both PoPs — the label reports INGRESS carrier even though Sinch-originated calls egress via the tc4 Bandwidth config). All zones summed — the Zone variable is SQL-LIKE shaped and does not apply to PromQL panels; per-zone CPS lives on Traffic Status.

Served by vmalert recording rule `trunk:kamailio_trunk_cps:increase5m` (30s eval). Raw fallback query: `sum by (trunk) (increase(kamailio_trunk_cps{direction="inbound"}[5m]))`. Recorded series only exist from the recording-rule deploy timestamp onward - on a now-6h wall any pre-deploy gap ages out within 6h. All zones (Kamailio metric, not zone-filtered).

panels.title: Answered vs failed by inbound carrier / PoP
panels.description: Answer/failure distribution per ingress carrier-PoP over the range + zone (inbound legs only): calls, answered (answer_time present), failed (never answered), ASR%. One row per (inbound_carrier, inbound_carrier_pop); '—' = no PoP attribution (trusted-but-unmapped Bandwidth IP or pre-attribution rows). This is the sign-off table for Sinch origination validation: a test call to 5305480845/46 must produce a sinch/denver or sinch/chicago row with calls>=1. Scoped to the selected range + zone.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(inbound_carrier, 'bandwidth') AS carrier, COALESCE(NULLIF(inbound_carrier_pop, ''), '—') AS pop, count(*) AS calls, count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL) AS answered, count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NULL) AS failed, round(100.0 * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL)) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS asr_pct FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND direction = 'inbound' AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY calls DESC;

panels.title: Top hangup causes
panels.description: FreeSWITCH hangup_cause counts + share over the range + zone. NORMAL_CLEARING dominates healthy traffic; spikes in NO_ANSWER / USER_BUSY / CALL_REJECTED / NORMAL_TEMPORARY_FAILURE point at destination or carrier problems. Top 15. Scoped to the selected range + zone.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(hangup_cause, 'UNKNOWN') AS hangup_cause, count(*) AS calls, round(100.0 * count(*) / NULLIF(sum(count(*)) OVER (), 0), 2) AS pct FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 15;

panels.title: Rated-call quality snapshot
panels.description: Headline quality averages over the current range + zone across answered, rated calls. 'Rated calls' = rows with a non-NULL mos (the RTP-metric denominator). If this count is low vs total volume, most calls are unrated and the quality panels above are a small sample. Scoped to the selected range + zone.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE mos IS NOT NULL) AS "Rated calls", avg(mos) AS "Avg MOS", avg(r_factor) AS "Avg R-factor", avg(jitter_max_ms) AS "Avg peak jitter (ms)", avg(packet_loss_pct) AS "Avg loss %", avg(quality_pct) AS "Avg quality %" FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND CASE WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'west%' THEN 'west' WHEN freeswitch_node LIKE 'central%' THEN 'central' WHEN COALESCE(freeswitch_node,'') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'east' END LIKE '$zone';

list.name: zone
list.label: Zone
list.description: Filter raw-cdrs panels by zone, derived from freeswitch_node (one FS per zone). 'All' = SQL LIKE '%'. Note: the hourly-aggregate panels (ACD, and the per-zone ASR panel) and the live Kamailio ingress panel (PromQL) span all zones regardless of this filter.
list.query: All : %, East : east, West : west, Central : central

title: Call Quality
description: Call Quality wall board — the full voice picture from the CDR hypertable (voip-cdr-pg). Top strip: last-15m live snapshot (ASR / Concurrent / CPS / Avg MOS / On-net %) on the selected zone. Priority band (two rows of three): MOS trend, packet loss, per-zone volume, total volume, SIP response classes, and THE carrier split — inbound by carrier / PoP (Bandwidth vs Sinch), attribution from cdrs.inbound_carrier / inbound_carrier_pop stamped spoof-proof by Kamailio at carrier ingress. Below, themed rows: quality detail (jitter / MOS distribution / R-factor / quality %), delivery (answered-vs-failed, ASR trends, ACD, PDD), carrier detail (egress share from carrier_used, per-carrier ASR, plus a live Kamailio ingress counter that shows a call at INVITE time — before its CDR exists), and diagnostics (hangup causes, rated-call snapshot). Long trends use the cheap continuous aggregate cdr_hourly_stats (customer-scoped, no zone/carrier dimension — those trends span all zones); recent/quality panels read raw cdrs and honour the Zone filter. RTP metrics are NULL on unanswered & unrated calls and are filtered out. PDD is approximated as answer_time - start_time (time-to-answer) — true PDD to the first 18x needs Homer/SIP timing, not the CDR. Infrastructure health (VMs / VIPs / media nodes) lives on the Infrastructure / Home / Fleet dashboards.
